title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: The Engagement Add-On to the Elite Bonus
content:
Ashbury Rewards members who stay often in the twelve months before the handling date earn an engagement add-on to the elite bonus.

**What is the engagement add-on?**
The engagement add-on is ten points when the elite night credits posted in the twelve months before the handling date, less the night credits reversed in those months, are at least fifty, five points when they are twenty-five to forty-nine, and nothing when they are fewer. It is added, in percentage points, to the elite bonus percentage of the member's tier for the elite bonus of a completed stay. The elite bonus percentage with its add-ons is never more than 100 percent.

**Which night credits count?**
Every elite night credit posted on the account in the window, less every night credit reversed in it. The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

**What are the bands?**

| Net elite night credits in the twelve months | Engagement add-on |
|---|---|
| 50 or more | 10 percentage points |
| 25 to 49 | 5 percentage points |
| 24 or fewer | None |

**Where do the boundaries fall? (hypothetical accounts)**

| Credits posted | Credits reversed | Net | Add-on |
|---|---|---|---|
| 52 | 3 | 49 | 5 percentage points |
| 50 | 0 | 50 | 10 percentage points |
| 26 | 2 | 24 | None |
| 25 | 0 | 25 | 5 percentage points |
